My approach: start with a 9-cycle to get all vertices at degree 2, then add three chords to boost six vertices to degree 3. Adding edges between vertices 0-3, 1-5, and 4-7 gives me the degree distribution I want. The resulting graph has 12 edges total and contains odd cycles, so its chromatic number is at least 3.
